infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GhostNet AI requires high-precision GPS to tag the exact coordinates of abandoned ghost fishing nets at sea.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GhostNet AI requires GPS access to track marine vessel coordinates when cruising across marine zones.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GhostNet AI uses the camera to capture photographic evidence of ghost nets and trapped wildlife.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GhostNet AI accesses photo storage to attach net imagery to incident reports.
